newsitem.title: INDIA: India to sell 7 pct of VSNL, 5 pct IOC.
newsitem.headline: India to sell 7 pct of VSNL, 5 pct IOC.

text.p: The Indian government said on Wednesday that it plans to sell a seven percent stake in Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) and a five percent stake in Indian Oil Corp (IOC). Both are state-controlled firms.
A government spokesman announced the plan to sell partial stakes in the two firms following a meeting of the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs.
Currently the government has an 82 percent stake in VSNL, the state-run agency which controls overseas telecommunications services in India.
The government has a 95 percent stake in IOC.
The spokesman said the shares could be sold in both domestic and overseas markets.
United News of India (UNI) said the cabinet committee decided to fix reserve prices for the VSNL and IOC shares.
While the shares would be offered to both domestic and foreign investors, a preference price would be offered to individual domestic investors, UNI said, without elaborating.
